verdict.rationale: The Division's public homepage offers a 'Check Entity Status' lookup, and the tax portal points to a public entity search by name, so a founder can see the status of a filed entity. Nothing documents tracking a pending filing, name-reservation application, or case through submission, review, and approval; the status lookup is only a one-line link with no detail on what it shows. Missing for 10: status tracking for pending filings, applications, or cases, documentation of what the status lookup returns, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Search for your business by name
